name: ClawVoice
subtitle: Your OpenClaw server. Your voice.
description: ClawVoice — a native iOS voice client for your own OpenClaw server, powered by the Gemini Live API for real-time bidirectional audio.

apps.name: ClawVoice
apps.subtitle: Talk to your OpenClaw server, no screen required.
apps.localizedDescription:
ClawVoice is a native iOS voice client for your own OpenClaw server.

Unlike basic TTS assistants, ClawVoice uses the Gemini Live API — a real-time bidirectional audio stream. You talk naturally, it listens, understands, and replies with native voice synthesis. You can interrupt mid-sentence. It hears you even with the screen off.

All the heavy lifting — memory, tools, web search, messaging — runs on your own OpenClaw server with whichever AI model you've configured.
